en.t: He imagined what awaited the dead in the world to come:

units.source_text: “这四十九日之内，亡魂飘泊在中阴[\[40\]](#part1333.html#m40)之中，

en.t: "During these forty-nine days, the departed soul drifts through the intermediate state,

units.source_text: 此后不知投生于六道[\[41\]](#part1333.html#m41)中哪一世界？”

en.t: and after that, who knows into which of the six realms it will be reborn?"
With solemn reverence, he recited the Buddha's name and chanted sutras.

units.source_text: 此后源氏公子会见头中将时，不觉胸中骚动。

en.t: After that, whenever Prince Genji met To no Chujo, his heart could not help but stir.

units.source_text: 他想告诉他那抚子[\[42\]](#part1333.html#m42)无恙地生长着。

en.t: He wanted to tell him that the little nadeshiko was growing up safe and well.

units.source_text: 又恐受他谴责，终于不曾出口。

en.t: But fearing that he would be reproached, he never managed to say it.
